from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
            if len(comp) != 2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4:
                continue
            if any(g[y][x] != color for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1) if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)):
                continue
            ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
            fill = 2 if ih % 2 == 0 and iw % 2 == 0 else 7
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if g[y][x] == bg:
                        g[y][x] = fill
    return g
PY
